```{r}
ecosystem_info = read.csv(here("..",
                               "1_data", 
                               "ecosystem_info.csv"), header = TRUE) %>%
  rename(ecosystem_ID = culture_ID,
         ecosystem_type = eco_metaeco_type,
         ecosystem_size_ml = patch_size_ml) %>%
  mutate(metaecosystem_ID =  metaecosystem_ID_vector,
         connection = factor(x = ifelse(metaecosystem == "yes",
                                        "connected",
                                        "unconnected"),
                             levels = connection_ordered),
         volume_disturbed_across_sizes = factor(x = ifelse(flow == "absolute",
                                                    "fixed",
                                                    "relative"))) %>%
  select(ecosystem_ID,
         metaecosystem_ID,
         ecosystem_size_ml,
         trophic_type,
         connection,
         volume_disturbed_across_sizes)
```
